question: In 4 dimensions, Tr(gamma^mu gamma^nu) contracted with g_mu_nu, i.e. Tr(gamma^mu gamma_mu). Give the number.
In n = 4 - eps dimensions, what is gamma^mu gamma_mu (coefficient of the identity)? Express in eps.
In n = 4 - eps dimensions, gamma^mu aslash gamma_mu = c * aslash. Give c in terms of eps.
In n = 4 - eps, gamma^mu aslash bslash gamma_mu = 4 (a.b) + c * aslash bslash. Give c in terms of eps.
In n = 4 - eps, gamma^mu aslash bslash cslash gamma_mu = -2 cslash bslash aslash + c * aslash bslash cslash. Give c in terms of eps.
Give the Laurent expansion of Gamma(eps/2) up to and including order eps^0 (use EulerGamma).
For I = integral d^n l/(2pi)^n 1/(l^2 - Delta)^2 with n = 4 - eps, the divergent part is I = I * K / eps + finite, where the first I is the imaginary unit. Give K.
For J = integral d^n l/(2pi)^n l^2/(l^2 - Delta)^3 with n = 4 - eps, J = I * K / eps + finite (I = imaginary unit). Give K.
integral d^4 l/(2pi)^4 1/(l^2 - Delta)^3 is finite. In Minkowski space it equals I * K / Delta (I = imaginary unit). Give K.
For 2 -> 2 scattering of masses m1, m2, m3, m4, s + t + u equals the sum of squared masses. For Compton scattering (photon + electron of mass m -> photon + electron), give s + t + u.
Massless e+ e- -> mu+ mu-: spin-averaged |M|^2 = K * e^4 (t^2 + u^2)/s^2. Give K.
Total cross section for massless e+ e- -> mu+ mu- at CM energy squared s: sigma = K * pi * alpha^2 / s. Give K.
Low-energy limit of the Klein-Nishina total cross section (Thomson): sigma = K * pi * alpha^2 / m^2. Give K.
One-loop vacuum polarization in QED, n = 4 - eps, MS: Pi(q^2) = K * alpha / eps + finite. Give K.
One-loop electron self-energy, Feynman gauge, n = 4 - eps: Sigma(p) = (A pslash + B m)/eps + finite. Give A as a multiple of alpha.
Same self-energy as before: give B (coefficient of m/eps) as a multiple of alpha.
One-loop electron mass shift delta m = Sigma(pslash = m) pole part, n = 4 - eps: delta m = K * alpha * m / eps. Give K.
One-loop delta Z2 in Feynman gauge, n = 4 - eps, MS: delta Z2 = K * alpha / eps. Give K.
One-loop vertex counterterm delta Z1 in Feynman gauge, n = 4 - eps, MS: delta Z1 = K * alpha / eps. Give K.
One-loop photon field counterterm delta Z3, n = 4 - eps, MS: delta Z3 = K * alpha / eps. Give K.
One-loop QED beta function beta(e) = mu de/dmu = K * e^3. Give K.
One-loop QED: d alpha / d ln mu = K * alpha^2. Give K.
For q^2 >> m^2 the renormalized one-loop vacuum polarization of one lepton gives Delta alpha = (alpha/(3 pi)) (log(q^2/m^2) - K). Give K.
QCD one-loop coefficient beta0 with nf quark flavours (beta(g) = -beta0 g^3/(16 pi^2)). Give beta0 in terms of nf.
